title: Curtiss-Wright
summary: US maker of nuclear-reactor components, valves and defence electronics.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Curtiss-Wright supplies reactor coolant pumps, valves, actuators and instrumentation to commercial and naval nuclear programmes, along with defence electronics and industrial equipment. Its nuclear business benefits from life-extension work at existing plants and from new reactor designs. Defence and energy budgets both matter.

Technology Exposure

  • Reactor coolant pumps and valves
  • Nuclear instrumentation and controls
  • Defence electronics and sensors

What To Watch

  • Plant life extensions
  • New reactor orders
  • Defence budgets

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
